name: AI BotKit –  AI Chatbot for WordPress
author: WisdmLabs

sections.description:
AI BotKit is the easiest way to add an AI chatbot to your WordPress site—no code, fully branded, and trained on your own content. Upload documents, select site pages, or add URLs and your bot is ready to answer with accurate, context-aware responses. Use it to engage visitors, capture leads, and provide instant support across your site.

What’s New

  • Train Once, Answer Forever – Build a knowledge base from pages, posts, PDFs, and external links.
  • Lead Capture (beta/coming soon) – Collect contact info and feedback right inside chat; export to your CRM.
  • No-Code Setup – Install, pick content, customize tone/branding, and publish.

Use AI BotKit for customer support, FAQs, product education, pre-sales guidance, also use it site-wide or embedded on specific pages.

Why AI BotKit Stands Out

  • Easy Setup: Intuitive chatbot builder; zero coding required.
  • Flexible AI Models: Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude and Open source model via Together.ai
  • Cost-Effective: Transparent costs with Bring-Your-Own API key policy.
  • Unlimited Chatbots: Create as many chatbots required to engage customers and generate leads across your site
  • Data Security: Stores chatbot data locally on your WordPress site.

Features

Create & Manage

  • Chatbots for different pages, funnels, or audiences.
  • No-code builder: purpose, tone, and greeting/fallback messages.
  • Flexible Embed: floating launcher (shortcode) or inline widget.

Training & Knowledge

  • Documents: train on PDFs and other business docs.
  • External links: add third-party URLs to broaden context.
  • Centralized knowledge base usable across multiple bots.

Branding & UX

  • Custom avatar, colors, fonts, bubble/window sizing & placement.
  • Tone presets (professional, friendly, formal, casual).
  • Multilingual chat (50+ languages).

Leads & Analytics

  • In-chat lead capture and feedback (thumbs up/down). (Coming Soon)
  • Usage analytics: volumes, response times, tokens, and errors; insights on popular questions.

Integration & Compatibility

  • Easy WordPress Integration: Quick installation via the WordPress dashboard.
  • WooCommerce Integration (Upcoming): Enhance e-commerce functionalities (product queries, cart recovery).
  • Integration with Popular Services (Upcoming):Zapier and major CRM systems integration planned for future releases.

Compliance & Security

  • GDPR-Compliant Data Management: Data securely stored on Server, adhering strictly to GDPR.

Why AI BotKit Stands Out

  • Easy Setup: Intuitive chatbot builder; zero coding required.
  • Cost-Effective: Transparent costs with Bring-Your-Own API key policy.
  • Your business never Sleeps: A fully automated chatbot cater to your website visitors needs 24/7 even when your team is unavailable.

Benefits of AI BotKit

  • Automate customer support, freeing up your team.
  • Chat with visitors 24/7
  • Reduce customer support response time
  • Provide Personalised Customer experience
  • Guide and educate customers on your products and services
  • Collect information and data from the website users
  • Generate & qualify your leads on autopilot
  • Convert Visitors into paying customers
  • Cater to Global audience with Multilingual support
  • Increase user time on page and lower Webpage bounce rate

Pricing

  • Free Plan: All current chatbot features at no cost.
  • Pro Plan: Check Here

AI BotKit is made for anyone who wants to convert their website traffic into leads and automate customer support. sections.installation:
Installation

  1. Go to plugins -> Add New in your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Search AI BotKit, install, and activate.
  3. You will be redirected to Welcome page.
  4. If you already have AI BotKit Chatbot Copy WordPress Code from Your Chatbot
  5. If Not Follow the Onboarding Wizard and create your first Chatbot
  6. Activate Chatbot or your site/pages.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher
sections.faq:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q: How does AI BotKit work?

A: It builds a private knowledge base from your selected WordPress content, uploaded files, and URLs, then answers questions in context through a chat widget.

Q: Can I train on PDFs and external pages?

A: Yes—upload PDFs and add URLs during training.

Q: Will it support lead capture?

A: Yes—lead capture inside chat is rolling out; you can export captured data to your CRM.

Q: Is it multilingual?

A: Yes, 50+ languages for global audiences.

Q: Where is my data stored?

A: Your Data is secured on our server securely. See our privacy Policy for details.

Q: Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

A: Yes, you can fully customize your chatbot’s appearance using our intuitive visual editor, without needing any CSS or coding skills.
